thread:
Priya R.: I’m handing off primary in ~10m. Open pager for embeddings-prod in us-west-2 still active, p99 latency up and some 503s. Leaving Tom as secondary. brief notes below.
Tom L.: ack. leaving laptop on, will take primary when you drop. what’s current customer impact?
Priya R.: ~3% requests got 503 last 30m, error rate spike after a model rollout at 02:10. Most traffic is fine but a few heavy batch jobs are pinning KV cache and causing timeouts. Customers affected: search-saas (low), analytics-batch (med). ticket INC-2026-871.
incident-bot: Pager: embeddings-prod-usw2 | Severity: page | Started: 1823998900 | Symptoms: p99 latency 2.1s -> 10s, 503 ratio 0.03 | Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/embeddings/latency-503 | Current state: throttling enabled on worker pool 'embed-rt-usw2' (auto), alerts suppressed: false
Tom L.: thanks. first quick sweep: 1) look at worker queue depth 2) check KV cache evictions 3) consider reverting to model v2-small if rolling to larger weights.
Ethan M.: i’ll pull perf dashboard now — graph link: https://dashboards.redwood/prod/embeddings?region=us-west-2
Cara S.: note: we have recent config change to continuous-batching windows, could be interacting with new kernel selection. see PR #3456.
Priya R.: ops-runbooks-bot, paste quick mitigation steps for this runbook?
ops-runbooks-bot: QuickStop checklist for embeddings latency/503:
- step A: check queue depths: `kubectl get hpa -n inference embed-rt-usw2` and `redis-cli --raw LLEN embed:queue:usw2`
- step B: check KV cache eviction: `curl -s https://kv-proxy.usw2/metrics | grep kv_evictions`
- step C: scale pool up: `infractl pool scale embed-rt-usw2 --replicas 4`
- step D: throttle large batchers: set header `x-max-tokens: 512` at edge for known jobs (temporary)
- step E: if model rollout recently applied, rollback: `modelctl rollout revert embeddings-model --to v2-small`
Priya R.: I ran LLEN — queue is 22 (normal ~5). kv_evictions spike ~250/min. I’m going to scale pool to 4 now.
Tom L.: ack — before scaling, can we try throttling to avoid cold-start spike? I’ll patch nginx route for analytics-batch to add `x-max-tokens: 512` for 15m.
Priya R.: doing nginx change now:```bash
kubectl -n edge patch configmap routes --patch '{"data":{"analytics-batch":"x-max-tokens:512"}}'
```
Priya R.: scaled pool command executed: `infractl pool scale embed-rt-usw2 --replicas 4` — pods coming up.
Ethan M.: dashboards showing p99 beginning to fall from 10s -> 3.2s. 503s down to 0.8% after throttle. Metrics: CPU at 78% per-pod.
Tom L.: good. next: follow up on PR #3456 and kernel-selection flags — assign to runtime team to validate continuous-batching patch. I’ll open a short postmortem ticket summarizing actions and customer impact.
Priya R.: leaving detailed handoff: 1) primary -> Tom L. 2) impacted customers: search-saas (monitor), analytics-batch (throttled) 3) actions taken: scaled pool, throttled large batchers, rolled no model yet (rollback on standby) 4) followups: runtime team to review batch window PR, infra to set pool autoscale threshold to queue>10 5) links: runbook https://runbooks.redwood.internal/embeddings/latency-503, dashboard https://dashboards.redwood/prod/embeddings?region=us-west-2, PR #3456, ticket INC-2026-871
Tom L.: thanks Priya — I’m primary now. I’ll keep watch for 30m, will escalate to oncall lead if errors rise >1% again or p99 >6s. ping me if anything else. :thumbsup:
Priya R.: leaving now, thanks team :wave:
